Location: Between two lava streams on the west side of Senie
Quote: Looks like a buyer's market around here, eh? Got to tell you, I see a lot of potential, mate. Lava-front views, open floor-plan, plenty of ventilation …. It's a gold mine!

Location: On an island in the river north of the Brothers of Strife, above Armature's Upheaval
Quote: Definitely a breach nearby. And ooh, it's a rowdy one! This place is tense, eh? Might have something to do with the mountains strangling each other. Who's to say?

Location: On top of the ridge above Vivec's Antlers, on the west side
Quote: What a view! Aside from the coral over there. Be glad your silly face-holes can't smell colors. Ugh! That orange! It smells like … old figs fell out of an ogre's bottom. Let's find this breach, eh?

Location: Next to one of the larger steam pools at Wittestadr
Quote: Breach ho, mate! While you look, I will regale you with a hilarious joke! What do you call a lygosmotic dream-wave on its birthday? A ventswattle! Get it? A ventswattle? Oh, never mind.

Location: Across the river from Darkwater Crossing, by the waterfalls southeast of Fort Amol
Quote: Be careful around here, mate. This breach is surrounded by trolls. They're a lot smarter than you think. They're banging rocks together now, sure-but once they start wearing pants? Look out.

Location: In the river by the bridge east of Cradlecrush
Quote: Snow! Can we make a snow-thing? Snow-person? Whatever? You know, if you make it right, it develops a sad little soul! 'Course it melts later. Bit of a shame, that. But we can name it and everything!
So, Staff of Towers, eh? Lots of peril there, mate. I've got to admit, though, I'm very exited to see how it turns out! I'd say, what? Sixty-percent chance time folds inside-out? We'll see!
This stream's a pleasant enough place for a breach. Just watch out for beavers, eh? Sure they look friendly enough-but they're just little waddling balls of hatred. Seriously!

Location: At the top of the steps near the Throat of the World, west of Ivarstead
Quote: Another breach ahead, mate. Uh oh. I see many many stairs in our future. Well, your future. No legs, remember? But don't worry-I'll be right behind you … doing very little.
